title: Relationships
content: At night, when I'm in my world, the relationships I have with the people who appear in my dreams are distorted versions of people who have impacted my real life. Sometimes a person is almost blended versions of two or more real life loved ones, such as a person in my dreams I've met more than once although I haven't seen him in quite a while. He was a blend between my husband, my grandpa and my brother. I don't think marriage is really a thing in my world, at least in the traditional sense. Last night, I was in my world in an auditorium type room with people I grew up with, including an ex who in real life I really loved and basically embarrassed myself over in front of all our adult childhood friends. I'm sort of rambling here, but I'm trying to arrive at a point. I usually can have some degree of control in my dreams, especially in my mall world dreams. The one thing I can't control is my ex being part of my dreams. I don't want him there. I don't want to love him in the waking world and I don't want to be dealing with him in my dream world. What can I do? I'm a frequent lucid dreamer and am preparing a script in my mind I'm going to try to bring into a future dream. It feels so real, especially when I change or try to influence big subjects of my dreams. I've wondered this aloud to this group before but why do we all experience mall world? I read your posts and absolutely cannot believe that others are experiencing the same thing. I try to explain to my husband how real it seems but he is a person who doesn't dream, or at least he never remembers them. Thanks for reading, I know that was a bit of a rant.
